name: Vessel Kitchen (Sandy/Draper & Orem) "The Everyday" Roasted Chicken, Mashed Sweet Potatoes & Jasmine Rice
brandOrRestaurant: Vessel Kitchen (Sandy/Draper, Midvale & Orem near BambooHR, UT)
whyItWorks: Located both near BambooHR (Orem) and near TownePlace Suites Draper (Sandy/9400 S), Vessel Kitchen builds scratch-made bowls with herb-roasted chicken breast, slow-braised beef, or roasted salmon paired with steamed jasmine rice, whipped sweet potato mash, and warm focaccia.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Build a Market Plate or Bowl with Roasted Chicken Breast (or Braised Beef / Salmon), steamed white jasmine rice, and whipped sweet potato mash—ask for dressings on the side (many contain lemon/citrus).
watchOuts: Ask for sauces/dressings on the side so you can skip citrus vinaigrettes and spicy chipotle crema
